title: Close the Staging Gateway transaction certification authority loop

phases.objective: Provide the missing independent Staging Gateway transaction-certification path without weakening the existing apply gate or allowing caller-selected provider authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Prepare an exact-build certification-purpose plan while the dispatch certification row is pending.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A synthetic provider candidate is deployed and read back, the previous deployment and public identity are restored in the same cycle, certification is atomically promoted with the execution-plan success state, and a subsequent normal apply plan becomes ready only for the exact certified commit and policy.
steps: Create a certification-purpose plan bound to the exact source commit, policy hash, convergence-plan hash, server-owned resource binding and canonical Platform Admin Workspace.
Prove that a certification-purpose plan cannot be replayed through the normal Gateway apply path.
Perform a synthetic candidate Version upload and 100% deployment readback through the existing provider transaction contract.
Force rollback to the previous deployment and prove deployment, health and trusted-ingress restoration before issuing certification.
Persist exact-build evidence and atomically promote the dispatch certification and execution-plan success state.
Build a subsequent normal apply plan and require the exact-build certification evidence before apply readiness.
assertions: The certification CLI accepts no caller-selected account, script, provider target or credential value.
The managed Cloudflare credential and feature gate remain server-resolved.
Certification evidence is bound to exact source commit, policy hash and a SHA-256 evidence digest.
Certification has a bounded high-risk expiry and stale-build evidence cannot satisfy a later apply.
The candidate certification deployment is never retained after a successful certification cycle.
Certification cannot be issued unless rollback and public-state restoration are verified in the same cycle.
The certification row and execution-plan success transition are committed atomically in the Governance DB.
No DNS, custom-domain or Production mutation is permitted.
Synthetic tests perform no live provider mutation and secrets_included remains false.
